text: Unified canonical effect, MANOVA, nonnegative canonical, and signed cross-run Rayleigh on RelationValidationDesign plus the common Mvpa compiler and AnalysisResult shell. Added fold-scoped RunwiseCanonicalRelations for leakage-safe temporal preparation. Deleted all four specialized production result and streaming facades while retaining fMRI evidence builders and sufficient-statistic kernels. Verified mvpa-fit JVM and JS 41/41 each, mvpa JVM and JS 299/299 each, legacy freeze court, and git diff check.
